method_notes: Regenerated for review cycle 9 (review:9:1: capture-fidelity.mjs's outside-click dismissal check now drives a real CDP mousePressed+mouseReleased pointer sequence on a hit-tested inert header background point instead of dispatching a single synthetic `mousedown` event, and verifies via a one-time listener that the target's own `click` event actually completed; review:9:2: this matrix itself, republished from the same run) via ai/tasks/MEMORIES-0009/evidence/scripts/capture-fidelity.mjs + compare-fidelity.py — see that directory's README.md for exact prerequisites/invocation. These scripts replace every prior cycle's ad-hoc, uncommitted /tmp/mem0009-fidelity-v2 / -v3 scripts (review:5:2 finding: those could not be reproduced once /tmp was cleaned); they are dependency-free (Node's built-in fetch/WebSocket, Python's stdlib zlib/struct) and are hashed as provenance artifacts. Route '/' is captured full-page (captureBeyondViewport, clip height = document.scrollHeight) via headless Chrome CDP so every one of the 11 home sections is included, not only the top fold. Two techniques carried over from the diagnoses in review cycles 2-3 (both still required, now built into the durable script rather than a throwaway one): (1) default-state captures emulate `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` via CDP `Emulation.setEmulatedMedia`, since both the prototype (prototype/index/index.html:850-854) and this app's `Reveal` component treat that as an immediate-visible fallback for their IntersectionObserver-driven scroll-reveal, which otherwise never fires for below-fold content in a non-scrolling capture; (2) the capture script scrolls the full document in viewport-height steps, clicks through every Testimonials-carousel dot (non-current slides sit outside the horizontal viewport inside a translateX track), and scrollIntoView-plus-awaits any `next/image` still incomplete before taking the screenshot, since `captureBeyondViewport` never itself scrolls the page and native `loading="lazy"` would otherwise leave several below-fold photos unfetched. `reference` = prototype/index/index.html served file://; `actual` = a fresh `next build && next start -p 3100` of the current worktree. `mean_cell_color_distance` is a 16x16 grid-average-color-distance metric (documented, non-gating; compare-fidelity.py samples each image proportionally to its own height, since reference/actual document heights legitimately differ once real catalog content replaces the flat prototype mock) — `status` reflects an actual section-by-section visual inspection of the paired images (see `section_review` per entry), not a threshold on that number alone. `state=search-open` entries are validated via the numeric header/main geometry (headerHeight/headerBottom/mainTop/scrollWidth) AND `window.scrollY` in screenshots/geometry.log (not pixel color distance, since the static prototype's search button has no working overlay to compare against): the capture opens search from a deterministic non-zero scroll position (scrollY=600) and asserts scrollY plus header/main geometry are byte-identical after open and after each of the three dismissal paths (Escape, a real CDP click on an inert outside point, and the close button), with the dialog's DOM presence (`#site-header-search-popover`) explicitly asserted absent/present at every step rather than inferred from geometry alone; their `reference` field documents the closed-state default screenshot at the same viewport as the geometry/layout baseline the search-open state must not deviate from.
